description: This file defines the SharedHealthCheckManager class, which manages coordinated health checks across multiple pods using Redis for distributed locking and caching. It includes methods for acquiring/releasing locks, fetching/storing cached results, performing health checks, and checking the lock status, facilitating efficient and coordinated health monitoring in a distributed environment.

classes.name: SharedHealthCheckManager
classes.description: A class to manage distributed health checks across multiple pods, utilizing Redis for locking and caching to optimize health check execution and data sharing.

methods.name: str get_health_check_lock_key()
methods.description: Returns the Redis key for the global health check lock.

methods.name: str get_health_check_cache_key()
methods.description: Returns the Redis key for the cached health check results.

methods.name: str get_model_health_check_lock_key(model_name: str)
methods.description: Returns the Redis key for model-specific health check lock.

methods.name: str get_model_health_check_cache_key(model_name: str)
methods.description: Returns the Redis key for model-specific health check cache.

methods.name: bool acquire_health_check_lock(self)
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a distributed lock for performing health checks.

methods.name: None release_health_check_lock(self)
methods.description: Releases the distributed health check lock if held by this pod.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_cached_health_check_results(self)
methods.description: Retrieves cached health check results from Redis if valid and unexpired.

methods.name: None cache_health_check_results( self, healthy_endpoints: List[Dict[str, Any]], unhealthy_endpoints: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Stores health check results in Redis with a timestamp for caching purposes.

methods.description: Main method to execute a distributed health check process, employing locking and caching to avoid redundant checks.

methods.name: bool is_health_check_in_progress(self)
methods.description: Checks if a health check is currently underway by another pod.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_health_check_status(self)
methods.description: Provides current coordination status including lock ownership and cache validity.
